questions: Electronics wapas karne ki policy kya hai?

answers.answer: Electronics are returnable within 7 days of delivery, provided you have the original packaging and accessories [return_refund_policy:1.2]. Please note that items marked as "Final Sale" are not eligible for return or exchange [return_refund_policy:2.2].

questions: How long does a COD refund take?
COD का रिफंड कितने दिन में मिलेगा?

answers.answer: For Cash on Delivery (COD) orders, refunds are processed to your UrbanCart Wallet or bank account within 7-10 business days [return_refund_policy:3.3]. Please note that refunds are initiated within 24 hours after the returned item successfully passes the quality check [return_refund_policy:3.1].

questions: My name is Aisha. What is the footwear return policy?
My name is Rahul. What is the footwear return policy?

answers.answer: Hi Aisha! Footwear can be returned within 14 days of delivery, provided the items are unworn and have their tags intact [return_refund_policy:1.1]. You may also exchange footwear for a different size for free within 14 days, subject to stock availability; if the requested size is unavailable, you will receive a full refund [return_refund_policy:4.1, return_refund_policy:4.2]. Please note that items marked as "Final Sale" are not eligible for return or exchange [return_refund_policy:2.2].
